The grating spacing of diffraction grating A is and the grating spacing of diffraction grating B is such that . Which of the following statements are correct when white light is incident on the gratings?

I. Grating A has fewer lines per millimetre than grating B.

II. Grating B has fewer visible orders than grating A.

III. The angle between orange and violet light in a spectral order is greater for grating B than for grating A.

 

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
